entities.name: St Catherine's Church in Warsaw
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Catherine's Church is a Catholic parish church in Warsaw, Poland, in the district of Ursynów. The parish is the oldest existing parish, although not the oldest church, within the current borders of Warsaw. It was founded about half a century before Warsaw's Old Town.
